authorization.scope: One other judge under fixed contribution-v1 criteria and paragraph-ID citation; four existing answers and at most eight new calls.

arm_meaning: baseline=current judge, revised=challenger judge; storage keys, not prompt variants
selection: Pinned Pi 1.5.0 isolated offline --list-models lists the challenger as available and thinking-capable. Choose a named version from another model family, not a latest alias or a model selected after results. Listing is not proof a live request will succeed.
fixed: Contribution-v1 revised semantic template and paragraph-id-v1 contract; identical system/user messages per answer, source material, schema, component, execution guards and diagnostic transport
order: D02-A current first; D05-A challenger first; P02-A current first; D06-B challenger first

D05-A: Marginal value of shared personal-action sentence
P02-A: Preserve net-evaporation mechanism and causal connection
D06-B: Preserve articulation of both parties' concerns

gates: Review targets before preservation. Stop on transport/schema/ID failure without retry or rescue. Stop expansion on a demonstrated materially false diagnosis; optional suggestions, unresolved necessity and human/model disagreement are not automatically material failures. No prompt or model switching after output.
limits: Provider changes with model; compare configurations, not isolated model weights.
High is requested in both; provider behavior or clamping and compute are not proven equal.
Four selected individual answers, not four complete A/B question pairs.
Author-visible development labels; no independent holdout, automatic winner, accuracy or runtime adoption.
One result per answer per configuration; no stability or general superiority claim.
Human labels and reviews are audit-only and never enter requests.
Costs are estimates when populated; missing or unpriced cost remains unknown, not zero. Provider HTTP request counts are unmeasured.
